devdoc.details: Anyone may deploy an HCA from an approved implementation. A successful deployment is      permanently bound to the owner verified immediately after initialization.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

params.userSalt: An optional namespace or account-version salt.

returns._0: The owner- and implementation-bound VerifiableFactory salt.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. setImplementationApproval(address,bool).details: Approval changes affect only future deployments.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

approvedImplementations.return: approved Whether the implementation is approved.

deploymentSalt(address,address,uint256).notice: Derives the VerifiableFactory salt for an owner, implementation, and user salt.

hcaOwners(address).notice: Returns the owner certified when an HCA was deployed.

setImplementationApproval(address,bool).notice: Sets whether an implementation may initialize new HCAs through this factory.

userdoc.notice: Governs initial HCA implementations and certifies immutable HCA owner bindings.
